supersedes_scratch_migration.field: who reads, cleans and purges a deleted room; what a purged room answers
supersedes_scratch_migration.reason: a deleted room stayed readable (and its Storage objects listable and deletable) by everyone who was ever a member, including members who left long before the deletion, and a purged room's meta_append refused never-members differently from tenure members; now the deletion records final_members and only they read, clean and purge it (older deletions without the key fall back to tenure), and once purged every root member gets the same answer (DECISIONS D-017, D-018)

post_migration_shape.predicates_execute_anon: true via Supabase default privileges (revoke from public does not remove it); without a uid they answer false

acceptance.transaction: single DO block ending in a P0001 raise carrying the observations; residue afterwards: 0 members, roots, docs, logs, receipts, change epochs and Storage object rows
acceptance.delete_policy_method: Scratch blocks direct DELETEs on storage.objects with a statement trigger, so the policy's exact pg_policies expression was evaluated per principal
